name: harbor_get_gc
description: The garbage collection schedule and the outcome of the last garbage collection run.

name: harbor_get_project
description: One project in detail: visibility, storage quota and usage, vulnerability and signing policies, CVE allowlist, and whether retention and immutability rules are set.

name: harbor_get_vulnerabilities
description: The vulnerabilities found in one artifact (by tag or digest), most severe first, at or above minSeverity (default High).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: most entries to return (default and maximum 100)

arguments.name: minSeverity
arguments.desc: Critical, High (default), Medium, Low, Negligible or Unknown

arguments.name: repository
arguments.desc: repository name, with or without the project prefix

name: harbor_list_artifacts
description: List the artifacts (images, charts) of a repository, newest push first, with tags, size, labels and the result of the last vulnerability scan.

arguments.name: repository
arguments.desc: repository name, with or without the project prefix

name: harbor_list_members
description: List the users and groups that are members of a project, with their roles.

name: harbor_list_projects
description: List Harbor projects the server's user can see, optionally only those whose name contains query.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: only projects whose name contains this

name: harbor_list_registries
description: List the remote registries (endpoints) Harbor replicates to or from, with their health. Credentials are never shown.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: only items whose name contains this

name: harbor_list_replications
description: List replication policies with source, destination, trigger and the outcome of the last run.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: only items whose name contains this

name: harbor_list_repositories
description: List the repositories of a project, optionally only those whose name contains query.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: only repositories whose name contains this

name: harbor_list_robots
description: List robot accounts with their permissions and expiry, optionally only those with access to project or whose name contains query. Harbor lists project robots per project, so without project this makes one Harbor request per project. Secrets are never shown.

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: only robots with permissions in this project

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: only robots whose name contains this

name: harbor_list_webhooks
description: List the webhook policies of a project: events and target addresses. Authorization headers are never shown, only whether one is set.

name: harbor_system_info
description: Harbor version, authentication mode and URLs, and the user or robot account the server acts as (with whether it is a Harbor administrator).
